title: NASA Made Atoms Colder Than 1 Kelvin
closing: Extreme cold gives researchers a laboratory nature cannot easily provide.
question: What would you study there?

segments.say: Deep space sits at 2.7 kelvin in this comparison. Empty space is cold, but not the limit.
NASA's lab reaches 0.0000000001 kelvin. Human engineering beat the natural cold compared here.
NASA's laboratory orbits about 250 miles overhead. Extreme-cold research is closer than the distant nebula.
